title: Manifest correctly fixes reversed dependency direction from initiative canonical
description: The initiative's Feature Summary Table lists AM-3 as a dependency OF AM-1 (AM-1 depends on AM-3). The Phase 2 manifest reverses this to AM-3 depending on AM-1. The manifest's direction is logically correct (quick filters depend on the list view, not vice versa).
root_cause: The initiative canonical data contains a reversed dependency direction for AM-1/AM-3. The time_split command correctly identified the logical dependency direction and fixed it. This is a positive outcome, not an error.
recommendation: Document this as an intentional correction pattern: when the time_split command detects a logically reversed dependency in the initiative canonical (e.g., a filter depending on the list view it filters, not the other way around), it should correct the direction and note it in the manifest.
affected_phase: Phase 1.3 — Layer Remaining Features — dependency resolution
